Projektbeschreibung
URGENT!!! MEP Package Manager / Commisioning Manager for Data Centre project FRA-West (hyperscale, 32MW) - interim assignment, full time on site

Keywords:
- Data Center / Rechenzentrum / DC Construction
- MEP (Mechanical Electrical Plumbing) = TGA
- package management MEP contractors, Nachunternehmer
- Commissioning Level 1-5 (IST), Integrated Systems Testing
- LV / MV switchgear, Mittelspannung, UPS / USV, Generators (Netzersatzanlage)
- chiller, CRAH, Kälte, freecooling
- BMS / EPMS / Gebäudeautomation
- Cost control of MEP packages, change orders / Nachträge
- programme / Terminplan Primavera P6 !!!
- QA/QC, snagging, Mängelmanagement, handover to operator
- VOB/B + FIDIC Yellow Book (client is intl.)

Requirments:
- 10+ yrs MEP or construction PM, at least two DC projects
- english fluent MUST, german nice to have
- on site FULL TIME 5 days Frankfurt, no remote
- start asap / 11/2026, 6 months + ext.
- rate 950-1100 EUR/day all-in

Contractor side (General Contractor), NOT client side. Team: 6 MEP site managers + commissioning agent.
